rca_of_issue: Original bug RCA: `src/push.tsx` did a static `import * as Notifications from 'expo-notifications'` which — under Expo Go SDK 53+ Android — throws at import time ('Android Push notifications functionality was removed from Expo Go with SDK 53'). Because app/_layout.tsx eagerly imported PushBootstrap, the throw happened before RootLayout was ever evaluated, hence Expo Router reported 'Route ./_layout.tsx is missing the required default export' and 'Cannot read property ErrorBoundary of undefined'. Fix: expo-notifications is now behind a lazy dynamic `import()` inside src/push/adapter.ts, guarded by `Constants.executionEnvironment !== ExecutionEnvironment.StoreClient` (no-op in Expo Go + web). src/push.tsx became src/push/index.tsx which re-exports PushBootstrap and only calls the adapter after the auth session is ready. Verified end-to-end by the acceptance script (static + bundle graph checks) and by booting the web preview cleanly with zero console errors.
